message: Chrome and Edge now match Firefox: the Update button downloads the Chromium zip and a Reload Desk button restarts the extension, the service worker is woken every 30 seconds so unlock sync keeps running, and the toolbar has a static icon before the first green/red check. Firefox behaviour is unchanged.
chromiumMessage: Click Download update, unzip Black.Forest.Desk-chromium.zip over your Desk folder, then press Reload Desk.
